Use `uv` to install the documented SCGSim and OrPen source revisions into one project. Keep `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock` with the study so another machine can recreate the same Python environment.

## Create the project

Install [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/) and Git, then create a Python 3.12 project: 

```bash
uv init --python 3.12 scgsim-study
cd scgsim-study
```

SCGSim supports Python `>=3.12,<3.14`; use `--python 3.13` if that is the interpreter selected for your study.

## Add the backend tools

Choose the extra for the calculation. The base package resolves and plots returned results; solver-specific extras supply Python preparation libraries. They do not install the native Palace or AEDT applications.

| Extra | Use | Main added libraries |
|---|---|---|
| `palace` | Prepare Palace geometry, mesh and configuration | GDSFactory 9, `gdstk`, Gmsh |
| `aedt` | Prepare HFSS or Q3D models; use Q2D | `gdstk`, PyAEDT 1.3.0 |
| `aedt-epr` | Prepare source-first AEDT surface EPR | AEDT dependencies, GDSFactory 9, KLayout 0.30.x |
| `visualization` | Inspect solver-bound geometry | `meshio`, Pillow, PyVista |

For the Xmon lessons, add the Palace and AEDT EPR tools together with the exact public source pair from [Examples](../examples.qmd#public-inputs):

```bash
uv add 'scgsim[palace,aedt-epr,visualization] @ git+https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scgsim.git@0f6b4e5c54aff4891492976a5dd58387cc1a1787' \
  'orcapen-sc-pdk @ git+https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk.git@03b1bc783ba0372ba0df1a765aa5ee446b182080'
```

The SCGSim source/API baseline is version `2.0.0rc15`; the OrPen SC PDK is `0.1.0.dev2`. Its distribution name is `orcapen-sc-pdk`, while Python code imports `orcapen_sc_pdk`. The OrPen source requires Python `>=3.12,<3.14` and GDSFactory `~=9.48.0`. `uv add` records the resolved dependency set in the project's lockfile.

Check the installed distributions: 

```bash
uv run python -c "from importlib.metadata import version; print('scgsim', version('scgsim')); print('orcapen-sc-pdk', version('orcapen-sc-pdk'))"
```

The expected versions are `2.0.0rc15` and `0.1.0.dev2`. After adding a dependency, commit or retain the updated `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock`; on another machine, run `uv sync` in the project directory.

## Install the Xmon source pair {#install-the-xmon-source-pair}

The [shared Xmon input lesson](../tutorial-xmon-input.qmd) and its [Palace](../tutorial-xmon-palace.qmd) and [HFSS](../tutorial-xmon-aedt.qmd) extensions use the pair above. The source map binds the package versions, component factory and port/layer metadata used here. The canonical upstream notebook is a historical source; this pairing does not promise it runs unchanged, nor claim that it has been installed, prepared or solved.

For other public notebooks, use the revision stated by that notebook. In particular, older CPW and Circular Pad examples have historical PDK revisions and may require a different SCGSim pairing; their pins are part of those examples, not defaults for new projects. See the [curved-source history](../history/curved-source-installation.qmd) for the separate Circular Pad environment.

## Start Jupyter

Add Jupyter to the project and launch it from the same directory: 

```bash
uv add --dev jupyter ipykernel
uv run jupyter lab
```

Select this project's `.venv` kernel. Check that `uv run python -c "from importlib.metadata import version; print(version('scgsim'))"` reports `2.0.0rc15`.

## Install native solvers separately

The `palace` extra prepares Palace inputs; install the native executable separately from the [official Palace 0.18.1 release](https://github.com/awslabs/palace/releases/tag/v0.18.1). For AEDT, use AEDT 2023.2 or 2024.2, PyAEDT 1.3.0 and a suitable license. Select the AEDT release explicitly in each request; each Desktop transaction runs on the same host as SCGSim.

A version label is runtime provenance, not a capability guarantee for every optional native feature. For Palace Mask/Inset and curved-port requirements, see the [Palace capability table](palace-eigenmode.qmd#native-palace-capabilities).
